title: HackerEarth: Minimum Operations to Make Equal
description: Given an array `arr`, return the minimum number of increments or decrements required to make all elements equal. (Equivalent to distance to median).
constraints:
1 <= len(arr) <= 10^5
• Time: O(N log N) | Space: O(1)
explanation: Median minimizes L1 distance sum in O(N log N) time.
